name: B10-0191/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to keep supporting Ukraine against Russia's war and to step up military aid, including weapons and ammunition. It asks them to back Ukraine's peace plan, respond firmly to North Korea sending troops to help Russia, and overcome Hungary's blocking of EU military funding for Ukraine. It also urges EU countries to spend at least 0.25% of their yearly economic output on military support for Ukraine. This is a statement of position, not a law.

- The EU is urged to send more weapons faster and lift limits on their use; Ukraine is affected.
- Hungary's block on EU military aid money should be overcome; EU member states decide.
- EU countries should commit at least 0.25% of GDP yearly to Ukraine's military support.
